name: Design of Wide Band-Gap Device Based Power Electronic Converters
description:
-Comparative study between WBG and Si materials – bandgap energy, electron mobility, thermal stability etc. Layout of WBG power devices in modules. Dynamic characteristics of WBG devices and its effects on device switching.  
-Understanding the dynamic behavior of gate circuit, effect of stray parameters on gate circuit, and switching behavior. Evaluating the isolation requirement in gate circuit. Mitigation of EMI. Active gate driver – thermal management, EMI mitigation, and device paralleling   
-Effect of stray inductances and parasitic capacitance on converter performance, generation of EMI, evaluating stray inductance and capacitance (using open-source tools), design of busbars and interconnections in power converters , thermal management of converters, accurate evaluation of switching losses considering circuit stray parameters, device selection to optimize switching and conduction losses, heat dissipation techniques – natural cooling, forced air and liquid cooling   
-Relevant power circuits with WBG devices Isolated converters Totem pole PFC Single stage AC-DC converters
